title: Lane classifier and kbgit.py lane
goal: _tools/kblane.py holds the path and commit classifier; kbgit.py lane prints commit, lane and the deciding code paths; TestLanes in _tools/test_kblane.py plants a content-only, a code-only, a mixed, a merge and a backlog-item commit and asserts every auto_kinds and MECHANICAL path is content; git.md and tools.md name the command and kb/_self/map.csv maps kblane.py to git.md
notes: The sync gate runs selfdoc.py stale, so the docs of a new command go in the same commit.
